title: The merge button
concept: Merge the pull request, delete the branch, update local main

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Your PR is approved! Click the green Merge button on GitHub. Then delete the branch and pull main locally.

questions.prompt: What do you do locally after merging a PR?

choices.text: Keep working on the old branch

questions.explanation: Update main and delete the feature branch.

recap: After merging a PR, switch to main and pull to get the new merge commit.
